title: 第3章 时爆瞬杀挡我者死第4章 子夜凝金痕毒退青云剑修
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
lines: 苏余顺着通风井爬出矿洞时，天已经亮了。
他浑身是血，衣袍破烂，站在矿场边缘的乱石堆上深吸了一口夹杂着煤灰的晨风。
活着出来了。
他把从赵虎身上搜到的三块下品灵石揣进怀里，又把铁尺别在腰间，倒出一粒辟谷丹塞进嘴里。
辟谷丹入腹化作一股暖流涌向四肢百骸，缓解了几分疲惫。
但内心的疲惫缓解不了——四道黑痕盘踞在胸膛上，无时无刻不在提醒他欠了天道的债。
四道了，还差五道。
正盘算着下一步该如何，身后忽然传来一声暴喝。
“站住！”
苏余脚步一顿，回头。
矿场的总管事韩铁正带着两个手下从不远处奔来。
韩铁四十出头，炼气四层，在这矿场里是说一不二的人物。
他穿着一件半旧的管事袍，腰间挂着一柄百炼钢刀。
“那小子！”
韩铁在十步外站定，目光阴沉地扫过苏余身上的血迹——矿奴上百人，他并不记得每个矿奴的名字，何况苏余脸上糊满血污，根本看不清面容，“西三矿洞塌方，你居然活着出来了。
赵虎他们呢？”
“死了。”
苏余道。
韩铁脸色一沉：“怎么死的？”
“塌方砸死的。”
苏余面不改色。
韩铁盯着他的眼睛冷笑起来：“塌方？
你身上这血是人血，不是你的血。
还有你腰间那把铁尺——那是赵虎的法器。”
苏余默然。
韩铁摆了摆手，两个手下迅速散开将苏余围在中央——两个都是炼气二层。
“矿场规矩，矿奴私斗，杀无赦。”
韩铁居高临下地看着苏余，“更别说你杀的还是监工。
束手就擒，我给你个痛快。”
苏余看着眼前的阵仗——两个炼气二层的手下，加一个炼气四层的韩铁。
换做一天前他只能跪地求饶，可现在他有时间爆破。
时间爆破的伤害取决于时痕总量。
融合时王碑得三十点时痕，加上之前积累的几点共三十余点。
三十多点时痕引发的时序撕裂，对付炼气一二层的杂鱼绰绰有余——炼气初期时序脆弱，时序撕裂足以让心跳和血流在几息之内彻底紊乱当场毙命。
但对炼气四层的韩铁，只能造成轻微时序波动——心跳漏一拍、灵气凝滞一瞬，远不足以致命。
content_en:
It was already dawn when Su Yu climbed out of the mine along the ventilation shaft.
He was covered in blood and his robes were in tatters. He stood on the pile of rocks at the edge of the mine and took a deep breath of the morning breeze mixed with soot.
Came out alive.
He put the three low-grade spiritual stones he found from Zhao Hu into his arms, fastened the iron ruler to his waist, poured out a Bigu Pill and stuffed it into his mouth.
The Bigu Pill enters the abdomen and turns into a warm current flowing to the limbs and bones, relieving some fatigue.
But the fatigue in his heart could not be relieved - four black marks entrenched on his chest, reminding him of his debt to heaven all the time.
Four, five more to go.
Just as he was thinking about what to do next, a loud shout suddenly came from behind him.
"Stop!"
Su Yu paused and turned around.
Han Tie, the general manager of the mine, came from a short distance with two of his men.
Han Tie is in his early forties and is on the fourth level of Qi Refining. He is a well-known figure in this mine.
He was wearing a half-worn steward's robe, and a hundred-smelted steel knife hung on his waist.
"That boy!"
Han Tie stood ten steps away and glanced at the bloodstains on Su Yu's body with a gloomy gaze. There were hundreds of slaves in the mine, and he did not remember the name of each slave. What's more, Su Yu's face was covered with blood and his face could not be seen clearly, "The Xisan Mine caved in, and you actually came out alive.
Where are Zhao Hu and the others? "
"Dead."
Su Yu said.
Han Tie's face darkened: "How did you die?"
"He was killed by a landslide."
Su Yu's expression didn't change.
Han Tie stared into his eyes and sneered: "Land-in?
The blood on your body is human blood, not your blood.
And the iron ruler on your waist - that's Zhao Hu's magical weapon. "
Su Yu was silent.
Han Tie waved his hand, and his two men quickly spread out to surround Su Yu in the center - both were on the second level of Qi Refining.
"The rules of the mine, mine slaves fight privately, kill without mercy."
Han Tie looked at Su Yu condescendingly, "Not to mention that you killed the supervisor.
If you don't fight, I'll give you a good time. "
Su Yu looked at the formation in front of him - two subordinates at the second level of Qi Refining, plus Han Tie, who was at the fourth level of Qi Refining.
A day ago he could only kneel down and beg for mercy, but now he has time to explode.
Time Blast's damage depends on the total amount of time traces.
The fusion of the King Monument resulted in thirty time marks, and together with the points accumulated previously, there were more than thirty points in total.
The timing tear caused by more than thirty time marks is more than enough to deal with the miscellaneous fish on the first and second levels of Qi refining - the timing is fragile in the early stage of Qi refining, and the timing tear is enough to completely disrupt the heartbeat and blood flow and kill you on the spot within a few breaths.
But for Han Tie, who was on the fourth level of Qi Refining, it could only cause slight fluctuations in timing - a skipped heartbeat and a momentary stagnation of spiritual energy, which was far from fatal.
title_en: Chapter 3: Time explosion kills anyone who stands in my way. Chapter 4: Midnight condenses the golden trace poison to defeat the Qingyun sword cultivator.
